summary: Iteration 3 testing of CaterNation Media Library + global typography sizes. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases passed (GET/POST/DELETE /api/media, auth guards, /content/reset typography defaults). Frontend: full E2E flow passed — Media Library tab present between Testimonials and Site Settings, upload → grid update → delete works; Library picker on Hero image field lists uploaded media (picker-media-<id>); three new typography size inputs (type-hero-size, type-section-size, type-body-size) render with helper text; setting section_heading_size='2rem' → published → public site main h2.font-head computed fontSize = 32px (matches 2rem). Content reset run at end, size fields cleared, defaults restored.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js is 751 lines — consider splitting MediaPicker, MediaLibraryPanel, ImageField into separate files (>700-line guideline).
GET /api/media has no pagination cap besides to_list(500); acceptable for now but flag for future.
DELETE /api/media does not return 404 for missing IDs (silent delete). Minor: consider explicit not-found response for observability.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded and deleted a 100x100 PNG through both backend pytest and frontend Playwright. Content was reset via reset-btn at end so public design is at defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_caternation_iter3.py. Media list endpoint excludes binary 'data' field. Tab order confirmed: brand, contact, hero, marquee, about, services, dishes, counters, gallery, testimonials, media, seo (Site Settings), account, sections. Font-size overrides scoped via SiteHead.js to `main h1.font-head`, `main h2.font-head`, and body selectors using !important; injected only when values non-empty. Public design verified unchanged when all three size fields are blank.
